item.title: Pavement down at Kern and Smith, Remington work continues
item.description: A key section of the Remington project is now complete at Kern and Smith, but construction will continue toward Pinetree through May 2026

item.title: FAMU makes changes to academic programs as students voice concerns
item.description: Florida A&M University says changes to multiple academic programs will promote efficiency and sustainability. Some students argue the adjustments go against FAMU's identity and heritage.

item.title: Tallahassee neighbors review plans to upgrade Tharpe Street corridor
item.description: Northwest Tallahassee neighbors spoke up about safety concerns along Tharpe Street Thursday and shared the improvements they would like to see in their neighborhood.
